title: Radial Convex Geometry of Quantum States and Its Relation to Best Separable Approximation
summary: We study bipartite entanglement from the convex geometry of quantum states. Taking the maximally mixed state as a reference point, we define a geometric entangled-space quantity $G(ρ)=[1-L(ρ)]/L(ρ)$ from the relative positions of the separable and quantum-state boundaries, and introduce a relative entanglement degree $Q(ρ)=[(1-p)/p]/G(ρ)$ by comparing it with the robustness relative to the maximally mixed state.
